text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic theory of art design and advanced digital production technology, who are talents in independent network design and visual communication design. It actively develops creative potential in the students, enhances their thinking of combination of technology and art, improves network planning advertising, product packaging, planning, business planning and overall image of products such as creative design capabilities and ability to innovate. Students after graduation can work in the field of art planning, production and research and management in network operating companies, advertising, computer video entertainment product development and production companies, or arts and cultural sectors in the related. The major stresses the integration of the high-tech with modern art. It closely integrates digital media with creative industries, cultivating all-round art design personnel of planning, and production.
